## Concerns
- The purported source-30 question “Is it always possible to generate \(I_w\) by \(O(\mathrm{poly}(n))\) many generators?” is misattributed. Source-30 lines 173–179 do not contain it; that wording occurs in source-29 lines 173–179.
- The transposed clause of Conjecture 4.10 is classified unqualifiedly as “still open,” despite source-29’s broad statement that it resolves Conjecture 4.10 [lines 219–235]. The report must explicitly reconcile that declaration with the narrower theorem and the non-theorem transposition remark [lines 833–841].
- Consequently, the claimed complete source-30 extraction is not established as written.

## Unresolved certificates
